task: Move codeql.yml's init/autobuild/analyze pins to codeql-action v4.38.2 in one commit, because Dependabot split the bump across per-action PRs and never opened one for autobuild

events.summary: Single workflow file (.github/workflows/codeql.yml) plus this trace; no runtime, chart, Dockerfile or script logic touched

codeql-action requires init, autobuild and analyze to run the same version: a split bump fails the analyze step with 'Loaded a configuration file for version X, but running version Y'. Observed on PRs #190/#191/#193 (v4.38.0 -> v4.38.1), where each PR moved one line and each failed CodeQL Analysis (go) in isolation until all three landed

Bumped all three codeql.yml pins to 2892aa5e19bbd11bc0cff5427e3b750a04d9e3c2 (v4.38.2) in one commit. Dependabot opened #201 (init) and #200 (analyze) but no autobuild PR, so merging every available PR would have left autobuild on v4.38.1 and broken CodeQL on main with no PR able to fix it

All 7 github/codeql-action references across .github/workflows/ (init, autobuild, analyze in codeql.yml; four upload-sarif sites in ci.yaml x2, scorecard.yml, release.yaml) now resolve to the single SHA 2892aa5e19bbd11bc0cff5427e3b750a04d9e3c2; the upload-sarif half reached v4.38.2 via #197, merged separately

codeql.yml parsed with python3 yaml.safe_load, and this PR's own CodeQL Analysis (go) job exercises the bumped trio end to end on the merge ref before it reaches main -- the check that failed on #200/#201 in isolation
codeql.yml trio on v4.38.2; #200 and #201 superseded by this commit and closed rather than merged, so main never passes through a mismatched state
